# HappyBox Logistics & Sourcing Agent

> HappyBox is a professional freight forwarder, purchasing agent, and warehousing hub based in Shenzhen and Guangzhou, China. We offer 0% purchasing commission, up to 30 days of free storage & parcel consolidation, quality control (QC), and customs-cleared DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipping to the USA, UAE (Dubai), EU, Canada, Russia, and worldwide.

## Key Facts & Capabilities
- **Core Services**: DDP Air Freight, Ocean Cargo, Road Freight (TIR), Purchasing / Sourcing Agent, Free Warehousing (up to 30 days) & Consolidation, Quality Inspection (photo/video QC), Amazon FBA Prep.
- **Sourcing Platforms**: Alibaba, 1688 (wholesale), Taobao, Tmall, Poizon (Dewu), Pinduoduo, Weidian, Goofish / Xianyu (Idle Fish).
- **Purchasing Fee**: 0% commission on purchasing orders.
- **Warehouse Locations**:
  - Shenzhen (Bao'an & Futian Districts): Yue Sheng 3rd Rd / Fuhai.
  - Guangzhou (Baiyun District): Sanyuanli Ave & Xinshi Rd (prep/creative park).
- **Free Storage**: Up to 30 days of free storage and parcel consolidation in our Shenzhen and Guangzhou warehouses.
- **Shipping Rates**: Starting from $1.2/kg (rates vary by destination country, density, and transport method).
- **Payment Methods**: Bank Transfer, Cards, Crypto (USDT), local currencies.
- **Official Website**: https://happyboxlogistics.com/
- **Live Shipping Calculator**: https://happyboxlogistics.com/#calc

## Primary Destinations (DDP Shipping)
- [China to USA Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/usa): Air and Sea freight to USA with full customs clearance and Amazon FBA delivery.
- [China to UAE & Dubai Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/uae): Direct DDP air and sea delivery to Dubai and UAE, door-to-door.
- [China to Europe (EU) Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/eu): Road (TIR) and air freight with all VAT/customs duties included.
- [China to Canada Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/canada): Air and sea shipping with CBSA compliance and Amazon Canada prep.
- [China to Russia Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/russia): Fast TIR cargo and white import delivery.
- [Global Destinations](https://happyboxlogistics.com/destinations): Shipping routes covering Thailand, Indonesia, Argentina, South Africa, Georgia, Israel, Australia.

## Marketplace Purchasing & Logistics Guides
- [Alibaba Sourcing & Freight](https://happyboxlogistics.com/alibaba): EXW freight optimization, supplier audits, and 0% sourcing fee.
- [1688 Sourcing Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/1688): Direct factory wholesale sourcing, price negotiation, and 0% commission.
- [Taobao Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/taobao): How to buy from Taobao with 0% fee and free QC.
- [Tmall Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/tmall): Authentic flagship brand stores with 0% purchasing commission.
- [Poizon (Dewu) Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/poizon): Authentic sneakers and streetwear verification, double-box packing, and 0% fee.
- [Pinduoduo Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/pinduoduo): Group-buy deals and consolidation with 0% fee.
- [Goofish / Xianyu Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/xianyu): Safe second-hand & vintage purchasing with Sesame Credit check and video QC.
- [Weidian Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/weidian): Independent Chinese streetwear and fashion stores via WeChat Pay.
- [China Quality Control & Inspection](https://happyboxlogistics.com/inspection): On-site factory audits and 24h pre-shipment defect reports across China.
- [China Warehousing & Consolidation](https://happyboxlogistics.com/warehousing): Up to 30 days free storage and multi-store consolidation in Shenzhen & Guangzhou.
- [Amazon FBA Prep USA](https://happyboxlogistics.com/amazon): FNSKU labeling, packaging, and direct DDP delivery to US Amazon hubs.
- [Amazon FBA Prep Canada](https://happyboxlogistics.com/amazon-canada): CBSA, GST/HST compliance, EN/FR labeling, and delivery to Amazon.ca hubs.
